suggestions.name: Gigabyte Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming OC 16GB
suggestions.why: Same RX 9070 XT chip and 16GB as the ASUS Prime OC, with a slightly higher factory boost (3060 vs 3030 MHz) and the same 3× 8-pin power. At 288mm long and about 56mm thick it fits the Z20 with room to spare (81mm with the bottom fan, limit 89mm). Trade-off: it has RGB lighting and is a touch thicker than the Prime.

suggestions.name: Arctic P12 Pro PST 5-pack (120mm)
suggestions.why: Standard version of the same fan; the current pick is the low-noise (LN) variant. Higher top speed means more airflow headroom, but LN idles slower and quieter. Same 120×25mm frame and PST daisy-chain, so fit and wiring don't change.

suggestions.name: KLEVV FIT V 32GB (2×16GB) DDR5-6000 CL30, black
suggestions.why: The same low-profile KLEVV kit in black, but CL30 rather than CL28: a timing difference you'd struggle to notice in games. Same 33mm height, so it still clears the cooler. About £20 more than the white kit.
